description: Unity Foods Limited was incorporated in Pakistan in 1991 as a Private Limited Company under the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (now Companies Act, 2017) and subsequently converted into a Public Limited Company on June 16, 1991. The principal business activity of the Company has been changed from yarn manufacturing to edible oil extraction, refining and related businesses.
